concepts.name: Safe Expected Direction
concepts.visualMetaphor: A clear product-specific metaphor that avoids generic dashboard defaults.
concepts.composition: Describe the first-screen structure, spatial hierarchy, and primary zones.
concepts.focalObject: Name the object that dominates the first viewport.
concepts.emotionalHook: Explain why the user should care before details appear.
concepts.whatIsHidden: List dense details hidden until after the first meaningful action.
concepts.whatIsAbsent: List cliches, extra panels, badges, or noise intentionally excluded.
concepts.clicheAvoidance: Name the obvious theme route and how this concept avoids it.
concepts.desireMechanism: Explain what makes the primary object desirable to choose or inspect.
concepts.desktop1440Strategy: Explain how the composition uses wide space without scale inflation.
concepts.tablet768Strategy: Explain the tablet layout and what collapses or reflows.
concepts.mobile390Strategy: Explain the mobile first viewport, primary object, and action.
concepts.failureMode: Name what would make this concept fail.

concepts.name: More Original Art-Directed Direction
concepts.visualMetaphor: A stronger, less obvious metaphor tied to the product's core action.
concepts.composition: Describe the staged or object-led composition.
concepts.focalObject: Name the dominant object, scene, or comparison moment.
concepts.emotionalHook: Explain the mood or desire created before details.
concepts.whatIsHidden: List information deferred until selection or inspection.
concepts.whatIsAbsent: List expected app-builder tropes intentionally removed.
concepts.clicheAvoidance: Explain how it avoids obvious AI slop or genre literalism.
concepts.desireMechanism: Explain the visual or interaction reward that makes users click.
concepts.desktop1440Strategy: Explain the desktop composition and supporting context.
concepts.tablet768Strategy: Explain the tablet structure and preserved focal object.
concepts.mobile390Strategy: Explain the mobile stack and no-horizontal-scroll plan.
concepts.failureMode: Name the risk that would collapse this into generic UI.

concepts.name: Wild But Controlled Direction
concepts.visualMetaphor: A bold metaphor that still serves the product rather than decoration.
concepts.composition: Describe the most differentiated first-screen layout.
concepts.focalObject: Name the object or scene that carries the concept.
concepts.whatIsHidden: List technical or secondary content hidden initially.
concepts.clicheAvoidance: Explain how boldness avoids theme cliche and badge soup.
concepts.desireMechanism: Explain how hover, selection, or reveal creates reward.
concepts.desktop1440Strategy: Explain the wide-screen drama without attacking the user with scale.
concepts.tablet768Strategy: Explain the tablet composition and interaction.
concepts.mobile390Strategy: Explain the mobile crop, primary action, and readable zones.
concepts.failureMode: Name what would make the concept too noisy, childish, or unclear.
